title: Identification of Time-Series Pattern Marker in Its Application to Mortality Analysis of Pneumonia Patients in Intensive Care Unit
summary: Historical MIMIC-III EHR time-series study identifies changing mortality-associated markers in ICU pneumonia. Compared LSTM/RNN/GRU and conventional ML; LSTM highest AUROC among sequence models with 10-fold CV and 8:2 split. Exploratory associations, not causal or prospective. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.

evidence.tested: Historical MIMIC-III EHR time-series study identifies changing mortality-associated markers in ICU pneumonia. Compared LSTM/RNN/GRU and conventional ML; LSTM highest AUROC among sequence models with 10-fold CV and 8:2 split. Exploratory associations, not causal or prospective.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
evidence.ai_role: §§3–5: sequence learning on temporal EHR inputs predicts mortality and temporal-pattern scoring identifies markers.
